global_summary: A documentary-style video showcasing the origins and culture of parkour (free-running) in France, focusing on David Belle and the Yamakasi group. It features extensive footage of athletic parkour movements across urban environments, interviews, nostalgic family moments, and street dance performances, all framed within early 2000s French television reports (TF1).
reason: The overwhelming majority of segments depict parkour/free-running stunts, athletic movements, and related street dance performances, strongly indicating a sports theme.
